reference: Within-stage minimum mean DEV CE window; earliest tie. Separate maximum mean DEV F1 window. Existing observed DEV only, no Test/outerVAL.
absolute_fit_DEV_gap: Report only; neither zero-gap requirement nor an independent overfitting verdict because TS/OS domains differ.
adoption: Original convergence AND new generalization screen must both pass. An unchecked or incomplete method is ineligible. Original PASS records are preserved and refer only to optimization stationarity.
threshold_provenance: New conservative engineering acceptance tolerances selected for the author's added requirement before re-audit. They are not universal statistical thresholds, a preregistration, or a proof of no overfitting.
MultiRocket: Numerical linear-system residual does not satisfy generalization gate; requires separate TRAIN-internal regularization/held-validation evidence.
scientific_boundary: Empirical screen for material validation deterioration and progressive Fit/DEV divergence on already observed DEV. Does not certify absence of overfitting or generalization to new dates/cows. Final untouched Test is evaluation only, never a tuning signal.
